section.para: Olivia has two different job offers for babysitting next Saturday.

list.item: Job 1: She will receive $5 for accepting the job, then $10 for every hour she works.
Job 2: She will receive $1.50 for accepting the job, $3 after the first hour, $6 after the second hour, and for each additional hour her pay per hour will double.

section.para: Olivia can only work 3 hours. How much would she make at each job?
